environment.description: Quarkus Lambda deployed via AWS SAM in us-east-1. Lambda function runs in a VPC with default security group allowing all outbound traffic. The function has an attached IAM role with AmazonEC2ReadOnlyAccess and AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole. API Gateway (HTTP API) is publicly accessible. Lambda ENI is in a subnet with a NAT Gateway providing internet egress. No DNS filtering or firewall appliance in the VPC. IMDSv1 is enabled on any EC2 instances in the same VPC.
